lines.japanese: 「……先生をお願いします、はい、分かりました」
lines.english: “...Could I speak to the doctor, please? Yes. I understand.”

lines.japanese: 「はい、今日は予約だけで……」
lines.english: “Yes. I'm only making an appointment today...”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとうございました」
lines.english: “Thank you very much.”

lines.japanese: 「ふうっ」
lines.english: “Whew.”

lines.japanese: 「おつかれさま。どうだった？」
lines.english: “Good job. How’d it go?”

lines.japanese: 「どうだったって聞かれても、今日は予約しただけだぞ。別に疲れるようなこともしてないしなあ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, how did it go? All I did today was book an appointment. It's not as though I did anything tiring.”

lines.japanese: 「緊張しない？」
lines.english: “Weren't you nervous?”

lines.japanese: 「……まあ、ちょっとは」
lines.english: “...Well, a little.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩と相談の結果、俺はカウンセリングを受けることにした。電話で叔父さん叔母さんに伝えると、しばしば相談しているという大学病院の連絡先を教わった。ふたりは前々から協力してくれてたみたいだ。
lines.english: After talking it over with Kobato, I decided to seek counseling. When I called my aunt and uncle, they gave me the number of a university hospital they said they had consulted often. It seemed they had been helping for a long time already.

lines.japanese: 居間の小さな戸棚の中に、いくつもの住所や電話番号の書かれたノートがあった。これらすべて、俺のための調べものだったと思うと頭が上がらない。
lines.english: Inside a small cupboard in the living room was a notebook filled with addresses and telephone numbers. When I realized all that research had been for me, I couldn't thank them enough.

lines.japanese: 「今年はもう予約いっぱいで、来年だってさ」
lines.english: “They're booked solid for the rest of this year. They said it'll have to be next year.”

lines.japanese: まあ焦らずに一歩ずつ進んでいこう。
lines.english: Well, there was no hurry. One step at a time.

lines.japanese: 「そっか。それじゃあ今年の残りは受験に集中できるね」
lines.english: “I see. Then you can spend the rest of this year concentrating on your entrance exams.”

lines.japanese: 「うえぇ……」
そっちは忘れてたあ……ていうか、小鳩って俺よりしっかりしてるなあ。
lines.english: I'd forgotten all about those... And wow, Kobato had it together better than I did.

lines.japanese: 「そっか、あったねえ、あったよねえ、そんなの」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Those. Entrance exams were a thing, weren't they?”

lines.japanese: 「あったっていうか、忘れてたの？」
lines.english: “What do you mean, ‘were’? You forgot?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yep.”

lines.japanese: 「ば、ばかもの」
lines.english: “Y-you imbecile.”

lines.japanese: 怒られた。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながら、前髪を吹きあげた。
lines.english: I got scolded. I raked at the back of my head and blew my bangs out of my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「いやあ、目先のことばっかりで、それより先のことは考えてなかったよ」
lines.english: “I've had so much right in front of me, I never thought about what came after.”

lines.japanese: 「いかんことだ」
lines.english: “That will not do.”

lines.japanese: 「受験かあ……今からでも先生たち、相談に乗ってくれるかな」
lines.english: “Entrance exams, huh... Think the teachers would still help me figure things out this late?”

lines.japanese: 「いかんともしがたい」
lines.english: “There is little to be done.”

lines.japanese: 「ていうか今月になってから受験勉強まったくしてないや」
lines.english: “Actually, I haven't studied for them once since the start of the month.”

lines.japanese: 「いかんにぞんじます」
lines.english: “I find this wholly unacceptable.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、やれるだけやるしかないよな」
lines.english: “Well, all I can do is try as hard as I can.”

lines.japanese: 「身体のことも将来のことも、一つ一つ前向きにやっていこう」
lines.english: “My health, my future—we'll face each thing as it comes and keep moving forward.”

lines.japanese: 「へいき？」
lines.english: “Are you sure you'll be okay?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだその疑わしそうな目は。大丈夫、なんとかなるって」
lines.english: “Wh-what's with that skeptical look? I'll be fine. It'll all work out.”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Okay.”

lines.japanese: そう、前向きにさえ生きていけばなんとかなるだろう。っても、俺たちは全員どこか抜けてるから、慎重さは忘れない方がいいかもな。
lines.english: Yeah. As long as we stay positive, things will probably work out. Then again, we’re all a little scatterbrained, so maybe we’d better be careful.

lines.japanese: 「まあそんな先のことは明日から考えるとして、いまは今日のことの方が大切だ」
lines.english: “Anyway, I'll start thinking about all that future stuff tomorrow. Today is what matters now.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ……あ、うん」
lines.english: “Oh... R-right.”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、さあ行くぞ！」
lines.english: “Ha-ha-ha! Come on, let's go!”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ！」
lines.english: “Okay!”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩を連れて柳木原の駅へ向かった。
lines.english: I took Kobato with me and headed toward Yanagihara Station.

lines.japanese: 「おいしかったねー」
lines.english: “That was so good.”

lines.japanese: 「だな」
lines.english: “It was.”

lines.japanese: 柳木原スカイなんとかってビルからほくほく顔で出てきたふたり。
lines.english: The two of us came out of the Yanagihara Sky-Whatever Building, beaming.

lines.japanese: 俺と小鳩は柳木原の街を歩いていた。
lines.english: Kobato and I walked through the streets of Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: 普段から賑やかなこの街は、文字通りお祭り状態だ。大まかには紳士淑女の皆さんが楽しげに歩いているが、稀に酔っぱらって馬鹿みたいに騒いでいる不届き者も少々。ときどき子ども。
lines.english: This city was lively at the quietest of times; tonight, the whole place was quite literally a festival. Most of the ladies and gentlemen strolled about in high spirits. Here and there, a few reprobates got drunk and made noisy fools of themselves. Occasionally, a child.

lines.japanese: 肩を組んで赤鼻を歌っている男ふたりがなんだか微笑ましかった。
lines.english: Two men with their arms around each other's shoulders were singing “Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer.” There was something oddly heartwarming about them.

lines.japanese: 「本当においしかったな、ひとにごはんを作ってもらえるのっていいね。うーん、食器を洗わなくていいのってしあわせだよ。やったね！」
lines.english: “It really was delicious. Having someone make dinner for you is wonderful. Mmm, happiness is not having to wash the dishes. Hooray!”

lines.japanese: この夢の世界のような飾りつけの中、俺の妹はやけに生活くさいことを言った。
lines.english: Amid decorations out of a dream, my little sister said something remarkably down-to-earth.

lines.japanese: 「包んでもらって持ってかえってくればよかったかな、えへへー」
lines.english: “Maybe we should've had them box up the leftovers to take home. Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、そう……だね？」
lines.english: “Yeah, that... might've been nice?”

lines.japanese: 「ケーキもおいしかったね。うちの近所にもあのくらいおいしいケーキ屋さんがあるといいね」
lines.english: “The cake was good too. I wish there were a cake shop that good near our house.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん」
lines.english: “Y-yeah.”

lines.japanese: 「明日吉川さんにお兄ちゃんといっしょにおいしい料理屋さんに行ったって自慢しちゃおっかな」
lines.english: “Maybe I’ll brag to Yoshikawa tomorrow that I went to a really good restaurant with my brother.”

lines.japanese: ちょっと浸りかけていた俺は、現実に引きもどされてこっそり涙目をぬぐった。
lines.english: I had begun to get swept up in the moment. Jerked back into reality, I discreetly wiped my damp eyes.

lines.japanese: 「でも本当にありがとう」
lines.english: “But really. Thank you.”
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「こんなに素敵な誕生日、初めて」
lines.english: “I've never had a birthday this wonderful.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “Oh.”

lines.japanese: 「ほら見て、柳木原って綺麗なんだね」
lines.english: “Look. Yanagihara is beautiful, isn't it?”

lines.japanese: 振りかえった小鳩は無数の照明を背中に受けて輝いていた。
lines.english: Kobato turned back toward me, radiant with a thousand lights behind her.

lines.japanese: 「あっ」

lines.english: “Y-yeah...”

lines.japanese: 「私、お兄ちゃんと来られてうれしいよ」
lines.english: “I’m so glad I got to come with you, big brother.”

lines.japanese: 当たり前だ。
lines.english: Of course.

lines.japanese: お兄ちゃん以外のやつとなんか来させるか。って言おうと思ったけど、考え方が卑屈なんでやめておこう。
lines.english: As if I'd let her come here with any other guy. I almost said it, but the thought sounded pathetic enough that I kept it to myself.

lines.japanese: 「それにしても綺麗だよねー、クリスマスが近いのかな」
lines.english: “It really is beautiful, though. Christmas must be getting close.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだな、クリスマス……」
lines.english: “Yeah. Christmas...”

lines.japanese: 「くりすまっ！？」
lines.english: “Christm—what?!”

lines.japanese: 「はひゃっ？」
lines.english: “Wha-ha!?”

lines.japanese: びっくりしたらびっくりされた。
lines.english: My surprise surprised her right back.

lines.japanese: 「きょ、今日」
lines.english: “T-today.”

lines.japanese: 「お経？」
lines.english: “To pray?”

lines.japanese: 「般若心経はどうでもいい。本日、トゥデイ。ジャスト・ナウ」
lines.english: “Forget the Heart Sutra. Today. This day. Right now.”

lines.japanese: 「ぱ、ぱーどん」
lines.english: “P-pardon?”

lines.japanese: 「２４日。クリスマス・イヴ」
lines.english: “The twenty-fourth. Christmas Eve.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ」
lines.english: “Oh!”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が目を大きく見開いた。
lines.english: Kobato's eyes flew wide.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そっか、私、自分の誕生日のことで喜んじゃって、すっかり忘れてた」
lines.english: “O-oh, right. I got so excited about my birthday that I completely forgot.”

lines.japanese: 「ごめんねお兄ちゃん、プレゼント家におきっぱなし……」
lines.english: “I’m sorry, big brother. I left your present at home...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、いいんだ」
lines.english: “Oh, no, that's fine.”

lines.japanese: ていうかそんなもの用意してくれてたんだ。そっちの方に驚いたっつの。
lines.english: Wait. She had actually prepared something for me? That was the real surprise.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう」
lines.english: “Thank you.”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の頭にぽんと手を置く。
lines.english: I rested a hand lightly on Kobato's head.

lines.japanese: 「はやや、私こそ自分ばっかい、いろいらしてもらって……」
lines.english: “O-oh, but I'm the one who should be thanking you. You've done all sorts of things just for me...”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとお兄ちゃん。私いま輝いてるかも。えへへ」
lines.english: “Thanks, big brother. I think I might be shining right now. Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 輝いてるよ。そう思って俺は小さな頭を左右に撫でた。つか、もっと雰囲気出したいのに、俺が子供扱いしてちゃ進まないわな。
lines.english: You are. I brushed my hand back and forth over her little head. If I wanted to set a mood, though, treating her like a child wasn’t going to help.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あのね」

lines.english: “Hm?”

lines.japanese: 小鳩の手が伸びてきて、頭においた俺の手に触れる。
lines.english: Kobato reached up and touched the hand I had placed on her head.

lines.japanese: 彼女の指がするりと俺の指の間に割りこんできた。
lines.english: Her fingers slipped smoothly into the spaces between mine.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、えっ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh...”

lines.japanese: 指と指を絡めあったまま、小鳩が俺の手をぎゅっと握る。
lines.english: Our fingers still entwined, Kobato squeezed my hand tight.

lines.japanese: 「夜にレストランでお食事して、こうやって手をつないで、まるでかっこいい女のひとのクリスマスみたいだね」
lines.english: “Dinner at a restaurant at night, then walking hand in hand like this... It's like the kind of Christmas a sophisticated grown woman would have.”

lines.japanese: かっこいい女があどけなく笑う。思わず苦笑いが漏れた。
lines.english: The sophisticated grown woman smiled with perfect innocence, and a rueful laugh escaped me.

lines.japanese: 「ええ？　小鳩も女の子じゃん」
lines.english: “What? You're a girl too, Kobato.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、私まだまだへっぽこだもん。まだけいけんち不足」
lines.english: “No. I'm still hopeless. I haven't earned nearly enough experience points.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかなあ」
lines.english: “You think so?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “I do.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩がこくんと頷く。ちょっと申し訳なさそうだった。
lines.english: Kobato gave a little nod. She looked almost apologetic.

lines.japanese: 「でも今はなんか、どきどきしてる」
lines.english: “But right now, my heart is sort of racing.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「クリスマスの夜に、手をつないでドキドキしてる」
lines.english: “It's Christmas night. We're holding hands, and my heart is racing.”

lines.japanese: 「私お兄ちゃんのこと好きになっちゃった」
lines.english: “I’ve fallen in love with you, big brother.”

lines.japanese: いきなりなのか今さらなのか、俺は告白された。
lines.english: She had just confessed her love to me—either out of nowhere or absurdly late.

lines.japanese: 「困ったね」
lines.english: “We're in trouble now.”

lines.japanese: 「いや困ったっていうか」
lines.english: “I don't know if trouble is the word...”

lines.japanese: 俺はいつの間にか汗ばんでいた小鳩の手を、さっきより強く握りかえした。
lines.english: At some point Kobato's palm had grown damp. I squeezed it more tightly than before.

lines.japanese: 「俺もポッポのこと好きになっちゃってるんだ」
lines.english: “Because I’ve gone and fallen in love with you too, Poppo.”

lines.japanese: 「困ったね」
lines.english: “We're in trouble now.”

lines.japanese: こんなときくらい真面目に言おうかと思ったのに、ついおどけてしまった。
lines.english: I had meant to answer seriously for once, but the joke slipped out.

lines.japanese: 「てへへ、うれしいな」
lines.english: “Hee-hee. I'm happy.”

lines.japanese: だけど小鳩のまっすぐな目は、強い意思を持ったまま逸れなかった。
lines.english: But Kobato's eyes held mine without wavering, their strong resolve intact.

lines.japanese: 「私、本当にお兄ちゃんのこと好きなんだけど、それっていけないことなんだよね」
lines.english: “I really do love you, big brother. But it’s wrong for me to feel this way, isn’t it?”

lines.japanese: そうか、もしかして俺が気づいてなかっただけで、小鳩は今日最初から……。
lines.english: Could it be that Kobato had understood from the beginning today, and I alone had failed to see...?

lines.japanese: 「いや」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: でも俺だって考えてなかったわけじゃない。
lines.english: It wasn't as though I'd never considered it myself.

lines.japanese: ただ、考えても逃げていただけだ。どこか曖昧にすれば一緒に居られると思ってたから。
lines.english: I had thought about it. I had simply run away whenever I did, believing we could stay together as long as we left things vague.

lines.japanese: だけどもう逃げることはしないって決めたばっかりだもんな。
lines.english: But I had only just decided I wouldn't run anymore.

lines.japanese: だからずっと思っていた俺の気持ちをいま言おう。
lines.english: So now I would tell her what I had felt all along.

lines.japanese: 「だとしても俺は小鳩と一緒に居たい」
lines.english: “Even if it is, I still want to be with you.”

lines.japanese: 「だとしても」
lines.english: “Even if it is?”

lines.japanese: 「うん」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「わわっ」
lines.english: “Wah!”

lines.japanese: 俺は小鳩の手を引いて、自分と彼女の体を合わせた。
lines.english: I took Kobato by the hand and drew her against me.

lines.japanese: 「でも今までずっと離れ離れだったから、求める力が強すぎたんじゃないかな」
lines.english: “But we were kept apart for so long. Maybe that made us need each other too much.”

lines.japanese: 「もしかしたら俺たちは、頼れる存在がお互いしかいなかったから、それを恋と錯覚してるのかも」
lines.english: “Maybe we had no one to rely on but each other, and we've mistaken that for romantic love.”

lines.japanese: 「ん……そう、なのかな」
lines.english: “Mm... Do you think so?”

lines.japanese: 「まだ俺も分からないよ」
lines.english: “I don't know yet either.”

lines.japanese: 俺は出来るだけ年上らしく微笑んでみせた。実際は心臓がばくばくもんだったけど。
lines.english: I gave her the most grown-up smile I could manage. In reality, my heart was hammering fit to burst.

lines.japanese: 「お互い広い世界を見て、将来それでもまだ好き合ってたら、そのときは叔父さんたちに相談しよう」
lines.english: “Let’s both see more of the world. If we still love each other in the years ahead, we’ll talk to your parents then.”

lines.japanese: 「うんっ」
lines.english: “Okay!”

lines.japanese: 「ありがとう、お兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Thank you, big brother.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩が近づいた体をさらに密着させた。
lines.english: Kobato pressed against me, though we were already close.

lines.japanese: その目が俺を求めてる。そこまでが彼女の精いっぱいだった。
lines.english: Her eyes told me what she wanted. That was as far as she could bring herself to go.

lines.japanese: ていうか自立まで手伝わせておいて、こんな時まで妹に世話を焼かせるってどんな兄だ。
lines.english: What kind of brother lets his little sister help him stand on his own, then expects her to make the first move too?

lines.japanese: 頑張れ引きこもり。俺は小鳩の両肩に手を乗せる。
lines.english: Come on, shut-in. You can do this. I set my hands on Kobato's shoulders.

lines.japanese: 聖なる夜。彼女の誕生日。きらめくイルミネーション。天井からちらほら白い小道具まで落としてきやがって、天気の神様まで味方してくれてる。舞台は完璧すぎるほど整っていた。
lines.english: A holy night. Her birthday. Illuminations glittering all around. Even the god of weather was on our side, letting little white stage props drift down from the ceiling. The stage had been set almost too perfectly.

lines.japanese: だが彼女はまだそれを受けいれるには心が幼かった。
lines.english: But she was still too young at heart to accept it.

lines.japanese: 閉じた瞳の下で、胸元に寄せた両手を固く握っている。
lines.english: Eyes closed, she clasped both hands tight against her chest.

lines.japanese: 俺はそんな彼女を心から可愛いと思ったけど、同時にたまらなく愛しいと感じた。
lines.english: I found her utterly adorable—and loved her almost more than I could bear.

lines.japanese: で、その結果。
lines.english: And the result was—

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: おでこにチュッてした。
lines.english: I kissed her on the forehead. Just a little peck.

lines.japanese: 「え、ええええっ」
lines.english: “Wh-wh-whaaat!?”

lines.japanese: 「たはは」
lines.english: “Ha-ha.”

lines.japanese: 唇が触れた場所を押さえる小鳩に、出来るだけお兄ちゃんっぽく笑いかけた。
lines.english: As Kobato covered the spot my lips had touched, I gave her my best big-brother smile.

lines.japanese: でも俺だって恥ずかしい。不器用に作った笑い顔に小鳩も微笑んだ。
lines.english: But I was embarrassed too. My face twisted into an awkward grin, and Kobato smiled back.

lines.japanese: 「くすっ」
lines.english: “Hee-hee.”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ」
lines.english: “Ha-ha.”

lines.japanese: 「あはははははっ」
lines.english: “Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 俺たちは互いにしがみついて声をあげる。
lines.english: We clung to each other and laughed aloud.

lines.japanese: 街に流れでるジングルベル。空を覆うパウダースノウ。出来すぎた幸せに俺たちは笑いつづけた。
lines.english: “Jingle Bells” spilled out into the streets. Powder snow veiled the sky. The happiness was too perfect, and we laughed and laughed.

lines.japanese: 「ずっといっしょだよ、お兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “We’ll always be together, big brother.”
